source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Existing public labels match Hebrew 8–20, retaining 8:23 and 9:1–25. Common English labels 9:1–26 differ; no relabeling performed. Jeremiah 10:11 is Aramaic.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps challenge to scribal handling of instruction; does not expand into a theory of scripture.
Retains personified daughter and repeated peace rather than flattening to reassurance.
Adopts removal sense in difficult gathering verb and states uncertainty about last clause in note.
Uses tentative comfort sense of rare expression; note marks uncertainty and speaker ambiguity.
Keeps voices distinct through quotation and preserves idols as empty things.
Preserves shared breaking language and mourning voice.
Retains three questions and regional healing image rather than answering them.
Retains repository Hebrew 8:23 label and embodied unending lament; common English numbering places this at 9:1.
